items.question: Do customers need an app?
items.answer: Yes. Audeohost-Events (events & sound) and Audeohost-Live (sound only) are both free on the App Store and Google Play. Guests scan a table QR code and are listening in seconds.

items.question: How long does setup take?
items.answer: The Audeo-Portal can be configured in under two hours. Audeo-Server may need a short on-site visit to confirm Wi-Fi, cabling and screen layout.

items.question: Can we keep house speakers low but still offer commentary?
items.answer: Yes. Guests hear full commentary in the app while your house volume stays wherever your policy sets it.

items.question: Can different tables listen to different matches?
items.answer: Yes. Each guest picks their own audio feed in the app, so multiple games run side-by-side without commentary clashing.

items.question: Do we need special hardware?
items.answer: Audeo-Server is a small on-site device to manage channel audio. We confirm exactly what's needed during the site survey and keep the install as compact as possible.

items.question: Does the audio work outside the venue?
items.answer: No — by design. Audio is delivered over your venue's own Wi-Fi, never over cellular and never off-premises. That keeps it a genuine in-venue perk, not something guests get for free from the car park.

items.question: Does this help hard-of-hearing guests?
items.answer: Yes. Because audio goes straight to a guest's own phone and their own earbuds, it's functionally a personal hearing aid in a loud bar or a large auditorium — clearer than straining to hear a house speaker from the back of the room.

items.question: Can Audeohost connect to our POS or ticketing system?
items.answer: Tell us what you need. We'll talk through pulling menu and specials data from your POS, or handing off to your ticketing system so a guest can book a seat for a bigger show — the right integration depends on what you're already running.
